titre: Inscrits en Medicare Advantage aux États-Unis

2007.texte: rising from 8 million people (19% of eligible beneficiaries) in 2007

2022.texte: Medicare Advantage enrollment was just under half of beneficiaries, or 29.9 million people.

2025.texte: 34.1 million beneficiaries are enrolled in Medicare Advantage

2026.texte: 35.2 million out of 64.2 million Medicare beneficiaries with both Medicare Parts A and B
